items.name: mantle-errors
items.title: Mantle form errors
items.description: Maps @mantlejs/client errors onto React Aria form state: Unprocessable field errors to fields, everything else to a form-level message.

items.name: auth-provider
items.title: Auth provider
items.description: Session state for the Mantle auth blocks: persisted-session restore, OAuth redirect handling, login/signup/logout. Exposes useAuth().

items.name: login-form
items.title: Login form
items.description: Email/password login against @mantlejs/auth-local, built on React Aria Form + TextField.

items.name: signup-form
items.title: Sign-up form
items.description: Account creation through your users service, then local login. Duplicate-email and schema errors shown inline.

items.name: oauth-buttons
items.title: OAuth buttons
items.description: Continue-with links for the seven @mantlejs/auth-* OAuth strategies (Google, GitHub, Facebook, Apple, Microsoft, LinkedIn, X).

items.name: upload-dropzone
items.title: Upload dropzone
items.description: Drag-and-drop or pick files and upload them to a @mantlejs/storage handleUpload() service, with progress and typed errors. React Aria DropZone + FileTrigger.

items.name: realtime-list
items.title: Realtime list
items.description: A live find() result as a React Aria GridList; service events update it in place with no refetch.

items.name: mantle-pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation for a Paginated<T> result, driving $skip. Named mantle-pagination to stay distinct from shadcn's own pagination primitive it builds on.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A server-sorted, server-paged find() result in shadcn's React Aria Table: column sort maps to $sort, pages to $skip.

items.name: search-combobox
items.title: Search combobox
items.description: Server-side type-ahead search over find() with $ilike (falling back to $like), in shadcn's React Aria Combobox.
